# ReShiki 0.17.1

This release adds editable bends to compression tubing, improves tube-end
snapping, and expands the connected equipment library with valves, sample
cylinders, four-way fittings and flexible hoses.

- **Editable tube bends.** Right-click stainless compression tubing and choose
  **Add Bend Point…**. Drag the free leg or enter an angle and centerline
  radius. Each edit is one Undo step, and the equipment list updates the
  developed cut length. Attached fittings stay in place.
- **Tube-end snapping and reducers.** Drag either free end of a straight tube
  into a matching socket. Properties offers a matching reducer when the
  diameters differ. Accept it to insert and connect the part in one Undo step.
- **Air-actuated bellows valves.** Add normally closed valves for 1/4-inch,
  3/8-inch and 1/2-inch compression tubing, with a separate 1/8-inch NPT pilot
  inlet and matching adapter. Switch the air state and inspect the moving
  valve in Section.
- **Sample cylinders.** Add single-ended and double-ended stainless cylinders
  in 150 mL and 300 mL sizes, with connectable 1/4-inch female NPT ports and
  Exterior and Section views.
- **Four-way fittings and hoses.** Add compression union crosses in 1/8,
  1/4, 3/8 and 1/2 inch and 6 mm, matching adjustable half-inch tubing,
  stainless hose connectors with flexible hoses, and a braided metal hose
  with quarter-inch tube-adapter ends.

**File compatibility.** Drawings with editable compression-tube routes use
document version 41 and require 0.17.1. The new sample cylinders, bellows
valves, pilot adapter and braided metal hose also require 0.17.1 because
their equipment definitions use fields or connections added in this release.
Other drawings retain the document version needed by their features.
Drawings saved by 0.17.0 still open in 0.17.1.

Equipment and equipment libraries remain preview features. macOS release
downloads are signed and notarized. Windows and Linux downloads remain
unsigned. [Code signing policy](https://reshiki.com/developer/code-signing-policy/).
